extraction: Ollama vs LM Studio vs llama.cpp (2026): Three tools dominate local AI runtime landscape. All run same core inference engine (llama.cpp). 5 axes of practitioner comparison: GUI vs CLI, API maturity, model management, resource usage, ecosystem. LM Studio: desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) with GUI for downloading, managing, running LLMs. Dead-simple CLI: curl localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions. llama.cpp: raw compiled C++ binary in terminal. Quick answer: GUI + zero CLI → LM Studio; terminal comfort + scriptability → Ollama. Ollama: native OpenAI-compatible API server (ollama serve), excellent for scripting/automation, huge ecosystem integrations.
